mentions.name: Crystal
mentions.description: A development environment for working with AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex. It has developers constantly work across multiple features in Git worktrees so they can stay busy while their agents run, and includes built-in review tools like a diff viewer plus a quick button to run the application in different worktrees for testing.
mentions.problem: Staying productive while waiting on AI coding agents to finish their work
mentions.source_excerpt:
A new type of development environment for working with agents

https://github.com/stravu/crystal

It supports Claude Code and Codex, but has you constantly working on multiple features in Git worktrees. This way you are always able to stay busy while waiting on your agents.
